title: Design, multicomponent synthesis, and molecular modelling studies of tetrazole biphenyls as REV-ERBalpha modulators.
authors: Padma Bhavani, B; Reddy, M Sunitha
one_liner_zh: 该文研究四唑联苯类小分子作为核受体REV-ERBalpha调节剂的合成与分子对接，对象为蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，仅常规对接，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The efficient synthesis of biphenyl tetrazole derivatives was achieved through a one-pot multicomponent reaction catalyzed by iron nanoparticles supported on silica (Fe/SiO(2)). This green and sustainable approach offers significant advantages over conventional catalytic systems, including high yields (up to 92 %), mild reaction conditions (100  degrees C), and excellent catalyst recyclability. The methodology involves a Suzuki-Miyaura coupling reaction followed by an in situ [2 + 3] cycloaddition, with dimethylformamide (DMF) as the solvent. The use of Fe/SiO(2) minimizes hazardous waste, aligns with green chemistry principles, and reduces overall production costs. Tetrazole-containing biphenyl scaffolds, known for their pharmacological significance, were evaluated as modulators of nuclear receptor REV-ERBalpha (NR1D1), a key target in metabolic disorders, inflammation, and related diseases. Molecular docking studies, revealed favorable ligand-receptor stabilization, characterised by pi-pi stacking and hydrophobic interactions with the ligand-binding domain. In vitro dual-luciferase reporter assays using HEK293 cells confirmed agonist activity, with EC(5)(0) values ranging from 3.1 to 25.3 microM, indicating measurable transcriptional repression of the Bmal1 promoter. Among the tested analogs, 3d (4'-methoxy-4-yl) and 3a (2'-ethyl-2-yl) exhibited the highest activity (EC(5)(0) = 4.9 and 5.2 microM, respectively), supported by strong docking affinities (-8.2 to -10.7 kcal/mol). Collectively, these findings establish biphenyl-tetrazole derivatives as a novel class of partial REV-ERBalpha agonists, bridging classical sartan-like frameworks with circadian pharmacology and offering a promising scaffold for antidiabetic and metabolic disease drug discovery.
abstract_zh: 通过二氧化硅负载铁纳米颗粒（Fe/SiO(2)）催化的多组分一锅法反应，实现了联苯四唑衍生物的高效合成。该绿色可持续方法相较于传统催化体系具有显著优势，包括高产率（最高达92%）、温和反应条件（100摄氏度）以及优异的催化剂可回收性。该方法涉及Suzuki-Miyaura偶联反应及随后的原位[2 + 3]环加成反应，以二甲基甲酰胺（DMF）作为溶剂。使用Fe/SiO(2)可减少有害废物，符合绿色化学原则，并降低总体生产成本。含有四唑的联苯骨架因其药理学意义而闻名，被评估为核受体REV-ERBalpha（NR1D1）的调节剂，该受体是代谢紊乱、炎症及相关疾病中的关键靶点。分子对接研究揭示了有利的配体-受体稳定化作用，其特征为与配体结合域之间的π-π堆积和疏水相互作用。使用HEK293细胞的体外双荧光素酶报告基因实验确认了激动剂活性，EC(5)(0)值范围为3.1至25.3微摩尔，表明对Bmal1启动子的转录抑制具有可测量效应。在测试的类似物中，3d（4'-甲氧基-4-基）和3a（2'-乙基-2-基）表现出最高活性（EC(5)(0)分别为4.9和5.2微摩尔），并得到强对接亲和力（-8.2至-10.7 kcal/mol）的支持。总体而言，这些发现确立了联苯-四唑衍生物作为一类新型部分REV-ERBalpha激动剂，将经典沙坦类骨架与昼夜节律药理学相连接，并为抗糖尿病及代谢疾病药物发现提供了有前景的骨架。
